titleAr: التأكيد التلقائي لانستاباي: القرارات وزرار لم تصل ومفاتيح الإيقاف
titleEn: InstaPay auto-confirm: verdicts, not received, and the kill switches

operatorReason.text: platform kill switch and money dispute: a payment the bank never received is reverted by the platform owner, the merchant has no screen for it

ar: ليه مش لاقي مفاتيح التأكيد التلقائي عندي؟
عايز أرجّع دفعة اتأكدت تلقائيًا اكلم مين؟
en: Who reverts a payment that did not arrive?

steps: Super admin only; every write needs a reason, re-checks the session (fails closed) and is audited with actor and reason
Mode off | shadow | live takes effect on the very next decision (never cached); a revert is idempotent
POST /operator/instapay/auto/backfill (reason) burns every confirmed bank reference + proof hash in the shared duplicate index once; re-runnable, idempotent
edgeCases: Revert only applies to payments the system confirmed
Signed endpoint POST /internal/instapay/auto-confirm/not-received serves the owner's Telegram tap (HMAC, not a session)
